title: Verification snapshot runner
responsibility: Creates a clean commit snapshot, applies links and setup, runs planned checks, observes file drift, and reports declared artifacts and build identities.

inputs.name: SnapshotRunService.constructor.run
inputs.description: Repository root, verification config and run context for the exact commit.

inputs.name: SnapshotRunService.execute.plan
inputs.description: Checks to execute sequentially after setup and tool-version collection.

inputs.name: SnapshotRunService.execute.artifactPaths
inputs.description: Additional snapshot-relative paths whose existing bytes should be reported; defaults to an empty list.

outputs.name: SnapshotRunService.execute
outputs.description: Execution results, source drift, setup failures, tool versions, declared artifacts, optional build identities and build failures.
